-74.05610,40.27650.name: Reproductive Science Center of New Jersey
-74.05610,40.27650.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: William Ziegler, DO. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.14820,51.51745.name: Andrology Solutions
-0.14820,51.51745.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

39.20830,-6.79240.name: National Environment Management Council (Tanzania)
39.20830,-6.79240.desc: Tanzania halted its engineered crop trials in 2018 and ordered the material destroyed, after having permitted them. Reversal after approval is rare enough that this case is cited by both sides, and the trials were publicly funded research rather than a company’s.

-58.42000,-34.60000.name: INTA — Instituto Nacional de Tecnología Agropecuaria
-58.42000,-34.60000.desc: Argentina’s public agricultural research institute, which developed the drought-tolerant wheat trait Bioceres commercialised. The trait was made with public money at a public institute and is sold by a private company under licence — the standard arrangement in this field, and the public share of the return is a matter of contract rather than of principle.

-71.10300,42.33500.name: Harvard Medical School — genetically recoded organisms
-71.10300,42.33500.desc: Recoded the E. coli genome so the bacterium depends on a synthetic amino acid that does not exist in nature and dies without it, and cannot use genes taken from other organisms. This is what biocontainment actually looks like when it is engineered rather than assumed — and almost nothing released into a field carries anything of the kind.

3.87000,43.62500.name: Community Plant Variety Office (CPVO)
3.87000,43.62500.desc: Grants a single plant variety right valid across the whole European Union, and holds the register of them. A right granted here reaches 27 countries at once, which makes it the most concentrated seed-ownership decision anywhere: one office, one application, and what a farmer in any member state may do with a harvest changes. Its register is public and searchable by species, which is how to find out who owns a variety being grown near you.
